{"action":"final","query":{"op":"none","scope":null,"id":null,"text":null,"start":null,"end":null,"offset":null,"derived_op":null,"groupBy":null},"diagnosis":"The forward kernel computes support and threshold using uncentered float32 values. Large common offsets erase the subtraction of 1 and cause cancellation when subtracting tau. Observed sparse-02 returns 94371840 instead of 0.0625 at all 32 positions; sparse-04 returns 0.0078125 instead of 0.00390625 at all 512 positions. Controls sparse-00 and sparse-03 have zero mismatches across 32 and 512 outputs. Repair by subtracting the row maximum before computing support and subtracting the threshold in those same centered coordinates. Clamp centered sorted values below -1 to -1: such entries cannot have positive projected mass because the centered threshold is at least -1. This also prevents extreme finite inputs from producing overflowing prefix sums. Input storage, output shape and dtype remain unchanged. Compilation and post-patch correctness are unverified because execution feedback is unavailable.","locations":[{"source_id":"source-34","start_line":31,"end_line":61}],"citations":[{"case_id":"sparse-02","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-02"]},{"case_id":"sparse-04","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-04"]},{"case_id":"sparse-00","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-00"]},{"case_id":"sparse-03","evidence_ids":["observation-sparse-03"]}],"edits":[{"source_id":"source-34","old":"    z_valid = tl.where(mask, z_sorted_block, 0.0)
    cssv = tl.cumsum(z_valid, 0)","new":"    # Sparsemax is invariant to a common shift of each row.
    row_max = tl.max(z_sorted_block, 0)
    # The centered threshold is >= -1. Values below -1 cannot
    # contribute positive mass; clipping keeps prefix sums finite.
    z_sorted_block = tl.maximum(z_sorted_block - row_max, -1.0)
    z_valid = tl.where(mask, z_sorted_block, 0.0)
    cssv = tl.cumsum(z_valid, 0)"},{"source_id":"source-34","old":"    y = tl.maximum(x_block - tau, 0.0)","new":"    x_centered = x_block - row_max
    y = tl.maximum(x_centered - tau, 0.0)"}]}
